source_url: IN RFB no. 2.291/2025 (DOU 2025-11-17), revoking IN 1888/2019 and IN 1899/2019 - identified via consistent secondary aggregators (Legisweb, Hondatar, Michel P2P); primary text at normas.receita.fazenda.gov.br / in.gov.br DOU archive was NOT directly fetched this session (403/unreachable)
verification_caveat: THIS IS THE WEAKEST-SOURCED FIGURE IN THE ENGINE. R$30,000/month was the IN 1888/2019 threshold; research found consistent secondary-source claims that IN RFB 2.291/2025 raised it to R$35,000/month for non-exchange/foreign-platform crypto operations, with the monthly DeCripto filing mechanics (Arts. 7, 9, 18) taking effect 2026-07-01 -- meaning as of today (2026-07-30) this should already be in force. However, no primary text (normas.receita.fazenda.gov.br or the DOU archive) was independently fetched and quoted. Get an accountant or a direct primary-source read before relying on this threshold for real compliance monitoring; threshold_watch should still fire proactively at 80% of whichever figure is configured, but the figure itself needs confirmation.
